name: Grade 9 IT Summative: Physical Computing
description: Ten core first-trimester words for the Grade 9 physical computing vocabulary table.

words.definition: Information that goes into a system or program.
words.example: The button press was the input that started the LED pattern.

words.definition: The steps a system or program uses.
words.example: The code process checked the sensor value before choosing an output.

words.definition: What a system or program produces.
words.example: The buzzer sound was the output after the distance was too low.
The sensor, code, and LED worked together as one system.

words.definition: A tool or machine that does a task.
words.example: The Arduino device controlled the light and buzzer.

words.definition: A path that electricity can follow.
words.example: The circuit connected the sensor, resistor, LED, power, and ground.
The sketch told the Arduino when to turn the LED on.

words.definition: To send a program to a device.
words.example: The student clicked upload to send the sketch to the Arduino board.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem.
words.example: The team debugged the circuit after the LED stayed off.

words.definition: To try something and check what happens.
words.example: The student ran a test by pressing the button three times.
